conclusion.text: Merchant C fulfilled the order exactly as placed, the carrier delivered it, and the store's own remedy was available when the dispute was opened. The record does not support a finding that the item was significantly different from its description.

summary: The customer says the item was not as described. The order was for a mini projector, and the fulfilment record shows that exact item, in the quantity ordered, in the one tracked shipment. The carrier recorded delivery on 23 October 2026, and the dispute was opened four days later. The store's published refund policy offers a refund on an item returned within 14 days of delivery, a window that was open when the dispute was filed. The merchant requests that PayPal close this dispute in the merchant's favour.
